notes: Reviewed against the accepted alignment and left the unit structure and all heads unchanged; the only edit is to the s007 note, which cited rule 42 for the riding-along for. Rule 42 governs an improper preposition and none is expressed here, so the citation now rests on rule 21 alone.
Every s### and t### id is partitioned exactly once; no unit is empty on both sides, and every unit is aligned with both heads members of their arrays.

s007 τοῖς: taken under rule 32 (pronoun only, participle keeps that make) rather than rule 22 (whole them that on the article), because a participle follows. The competing reading would put t010-t012 on the article; rule 32 forbids it in terms.
s001 is anarthrous, so the supplied the is a rule 7 helper on the noun under rule 51's anarthrous clause, not evidence of an article to align and not an article to leave unrepresented.
s003 takes of + righteousness whole because no article stands to anchor a the; rule 21 forbids leaving a bare of on an article, and rule 23's determinerless case keeps the preposition on the noun.

Variant SBLGNT.JAS.3.18.v013 is underdetermined with r00-base among the compatible readings and carries no FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE mark, so rule 97 does not apply and rule 12 bars revisiting the reading inside this file.
The two εἰρήνη tokens (s005 dative, s009 accusative) stay separate units under rule 2; the shared lexeme is no reason to join them.
